Read the categories with care

The publishers' own labels are not reliable

Telangana marks 575 datasets as “Telecom” and gives all 709 of its T-Fiber uploads the identical four tags Fiber optic network, Telecom, Infrastructure, GeoSpatial — including datasets of ICD medical diagnosis codes, animal taxonomy and car prices. Those tags describe the upload batch, not the data.

Maharashtra marks 886 of its 887 datasets as “Agriculture”, which is true but too coarse to navigate; the sub-domains here split it into crops, horticulture, irrigation, soil, fisheries, livestock and food processing.

About 292 Telangana records are not datasets in any useful sense — they are internal tables of the Oracle APEX and Intergraph G/Technology systems behind the T-Fiber GIS: audit logs, page templates, picklists and schema dictionaries. They are grouped under IT / Application System Metadata so they can be excluded rather than silently inflating the infrastructure count.
